rekordbox.title.purpose: Heading of the panel that holds the settings about rekordbox.

energyStars.label.purpose: Label of the switch that sends energy to rekordbox as the star rating. It never changes with the state.
energyStars.label.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, the switch's label.
energyStars.label.approved: Send energy to rekordbox as Rating

energyStars.helpOff.purpose: Help under the switch while it is off: how energy maps to stars, and that energy stays in the app.
energyStars.helpOff.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, under the switch while off.
energyStars.helpOff.approved: Each send will set Rating in rekordbox from your tracks' energy (1 and 2 are one star, up to 9 and 10 for five)

energyStars.helpOn.purpose: Help under the switch while it is on: each send sets the stars from energy; tracks with no energy keep theirs.
energyStars.helpOn.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, under the switch while on.
energyStars.helpOn.approved: Each send sets Rating in rekordbox from your tracks' energy (1 and 2 are one star, up to 9 and 10 for five). Tracks with no energy keep their stars.

energyStars.offNote.purpose: Says what turning the switch off leaves behind: stars stay as last sent and rekordbox's rating counts again.
energyStars.offNote.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, under the help, right after the switch is turned off (until the user leaves the screen).
energyStars.offNote.approved: Stars in rekordbox stay as last sent. Your Library's rating follows rekordbox again.

energyStars.counting.purpose: Says the tracks are being counted before the confirm opens.
energyStars.counting.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, under the switch, while counting.

energyStars.confirmTitle.purpose: Title of the confirm that opens when the switch is turned on. A question whose verb the filled button restates.
energyStars.confirmTitle.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, confirm under the switch (title).
energyStars.confirmTitle.approved: Send energy to rekordbox as Rating?

energyStars.changes_zero.purpose: Says no track's stars in rekordbox would change; {{when}} is the date and time of the export read it counts from.
energyStars.changes_zero.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, confirm, count line (none).
energyStars.changes_zero.approved: No stars in rekordbox would change (export read {{when}})

energyStars.changes_one.purpose: Says one track's stars in rekordbox would change; {{when}} is the date and time of the export read it counts from.
energyStars.changes_one.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, confirm, count line (one).
energyStars.changes_one.approved: {{count, number}} track's stars in rekordbox would change (export read {{when}})

energyStars.changes_other.purpose: Says how many tracks' stars in rekordbox would change; {{when}} is the date and time of the export read it counts from.
energyStars.changes_other.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, confirm, count line (several).
energyStars.changes_other.approved: {{count, number}} tracks' stars in rekordbox would change (export read {{when}})

energyStars.noRead.purpose: Says there is nothing to count because rekordbox's export has never been read, and that the send review shows the number before anything is written.
energyStars.noRead.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, confirm, in place of the count line.
energyStars.noRead.approved: Can't count yet (no rekordbox export read). The send checklist shows the number before anything is written.

energyStars.confirmDetail.purpose: Says tracks with no energy keep their stars, and that a star rating changed in rekordbox later waits in Review as a conflict.
energyStars.confirmDetail.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, confirm, body under the count line.
energyStars.confirmDetail.approved: Tracks with no energy keep their stars. If you change a Rating in rekordbox later, you'll choose which to keep in Review under Conflicts. Turning this off later stops the sending, but stars already sent stay in rekordbox.

energyStars.confirm.purpose: The confirm's filled button; restates the verb of the question.
energyStars.confirm.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, confirm, button.

energyStars.back.purpose: The confirm's other button; leaves the switch off.
energyStars.back.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, confirm, button.

energyStars.error.purpose: Says the setting could not be saved and the switch is as it was.
energyStars.error.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, error line under the switch (alert).
energyStars.error.approved: Couldn't save the setting. Try again.

energyStars.countError.purpose: Says the tracks could not be counted, so the confirm did not open and the switch is as it was.
energyStars.countError.where: Settings screen, rekordbox panel, error line under the switch (alert), after turning it on.
energyStars.countError.approved: Couldn't count the tracks. Try again.

bundle.error.notOurs.purpose: Error: the picked file isn't a bundle this app made (not a zip with the expected contents, or not its database). (PROPOSED, 4B-B1a)
bundle.error.notOurs.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, error line.

bundle.error.tooLarge.purpose: Error: a file inside the bundle is larger than the app accepts, so it wasn't unpacked. (PROPOSED, 4B-B1a)
bundle.error.tooLarge.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, error line.

bundle.error.damaged.purpose: Error: the bundle's database fails its integrity checks; nothing changed. (PROPOSED, 4B-B1a)
bundle.error.damaged.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, error line.

bundle.error.newer.purpose: Error: the bundle comes from a newer app version; the user must update first. (PROPOSED, 4B-B1a)
bundle.error.newer.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, error line.

bundle.error.nothingStaged.purpose: Error: the user confirmed an import or a restore, but no checked bundle or backup is waiting. (PROPOSED, 4B-B1a)
bundle.error.nothingStaged.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, error line.

bundle.error.backupNotFound.purpose: Error: the backup chosen to restore has been removed meanwhile. (PROPOSED, 4B-B1a)
bundle.error.backupNotFound.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, error line.

bundle.title.purpose: Heading of the panel for moving the Library to another of the user's computers. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.title.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, heading.

bundle.intro.purpose: Says what a bundle holds and doesn't hold, and that the music is copied by the user. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.intro.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, under the heading.

bundle.create.purpose: Button that makes a bundle and then asks where to save it. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.create.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel.

bundle.creating.purpose: Wait text while the bundle is made. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.creating.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, status line while waiting.

bundle.saveDialogTitle.purpose: Title of the system Save dialog for the bundle. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)

bundle.filter.purpose: Name of the .zip filter in the Save and Open dialogs. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)

bundle.saved.purpose: Says the bundle was saved, with the file's name. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.saved.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, status line after saving.

bundle.notSaved.purpose: Said when the Save dialog was cancelled. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.notSaved.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, status line after cancelling the Save dialog.

bundle.import.purpose: Button that opens the dialog to choose a bundle file. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.import.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel.

bundle.openDialogTitle.purpose: Title of the system Open dialog for a bundle. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)

bundle.checking.purpose: Wait text while a bundle or backup is checked. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.checking.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, status line.

bundle.confirm.importTitle.purpose: Title of the confirm before an import. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.confirm.importTitle.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, confirm.

bundle.confirm.restoreTitle.purpose: Title of the confirm before restoring a backup. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.confirm.restoreTitle.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, confirm.

bundle.confirm.made.purpose: When the bundle was made and by which app version. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.confirm.made.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, confirm, first line.

bundle.confirm.kept.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, confirm, first line for a backup.

bundle.confirm.tracks.purpose: Number of tracks in the bundle. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.confirm.tracks.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, confirm, list.

bundle.confirm.crates.purpose: Number of crates in the bundle. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.confirm.crates.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, confirm, list.

bundle.confirm.playlists.purpose: Number of playlists in the bundle. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.confirm.playlists.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, confirm, list.

bundle.confirm.tags.purpose: Number of tags in the bundle. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.confirm.tags.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, confirm, list.

bundle.confirm.folders.purpose: Number of music folders in the bundle. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.confirm.folders.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, confirm, list.

bundle.confirm.detail.purpose: Says plainly what the replace does: replaces, backs up first, restarts. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.confirm.detail.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, confirm.

bundle.confirm.machine.purpose: Says what does not travel in a bundle. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.confirm.machine.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, confirm.

bundle.confirm.drives.purpose: Points to the Music folders screen for folders on drives that aren't connected. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.confirm.drives.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, confirm.

bundle.confirm.replace.purpose: Button that confirms the replace and restarts the app. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.confirm.replace.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, confirm.

bundle.confirm.cancel.purpose: Button that closes the confirm and changes nothing. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.confirm.cancel.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, confirm.

bundle.restarting.purpose: Shown after confirming, until the app restarts. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.restarting.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, status line.

bundle.backups.title.purpose: Heading of the list of Libraries kept when one was replaced. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.backups.title.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, sub-heading.

bundle.backups.empty.purpose: Says there are no backups and when one is made. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.backups.empty.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, backups list.

bundle.backups.row.purpose: One backup in the list: when, and how many tracks and crates. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.backups.row.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, backups list.

bundle.backups.rowUnknown.purpose: One backup that can't be read: only the date. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.backups.rowUnknown.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, backups list.

bundle.backups.restore.purpose: Button on a backup that starts restoring it. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.backups.restore.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, backups list.

bundle.save.notABundle.purpose: Error: the file to save isn't a bundle in the app's folder. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.save.notABundle.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, error line.

bundle.save.notZip.purpose: Error: the chosen file name doesn't end in .zip. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.save.notZip.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, error line.

bundle.save.exists.purpose: Error: something already exists at the chosen place. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.save.exists.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, error line.

bundle.save.folderMissing.purpose: Error: the chosen folder doesn't exist. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.save.folderMissing.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, error line.

bundle.save.folderNotPlain.purpose: Error: the folder is a link or junction, or isn't a folder. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.save.folderNotPlain.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, error line.

bundle.save.inMusicFolder.purpose: Error: the chosen place is inside a music folder. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.save.inMusicFolder.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, error line.

bundle.save.inAppData.purpose: Error: the chosen place is inside the app's data folder. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.save.inAppData.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, error line.

bundle.save.gigStick.purpose: Error: the drive has a PIONEER or Contents folder. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.save.gigStick.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, error line.

bundle.save.inRekordboxFolder.purpose: Error: the chosen place is inside rekordbox's data folder. (PROPOSED, 4B-B2)
bundle.save.inRekordboxFolder.where: Settings screen, Move to another computer panel, error line.
